acceptance_boundary: Accepts a source-grounded opportunity assessment and conditional pilot recommendation only. Does not accept a manufacturing route, demonstrate an autonomous bench, or validate a business.

recommendation.title: Develop and verify a durable thermal interface and mounting configuration for a new accelerator assembly
recommendation.owner: Package/cooling-module developer or server thermal team with authority over the accessible interface and retention/local cooling boundaries.
recommendation.trigger: Authentic new assembly loses thermal margin after power cycling or under representative spatial load/assembly variation. No selected GB300 defect alleged.
editable_variables: retention and contact geometry within package limits
plate and local fluid-path variants under owner control
recommendation.stimulus: Calibrated spatial heat patterns, controlled inlet/flow conditions and owner-defined cycling.
sensing: flow and differential pressure with fixture baseline
recommendation.physical_return: Preserve aged evidence; choose a controlled contact/material versus fluid/plate intervention; build a fresh traceable variant; repeat and independently verify.
recommendation.deliverable: Qualified engineering change/assembly recipe, raw evidence, uncertainty, tested operating envelope and remaining limits.
recommendation.llm_role: Proposed interpretation of heterogeneous evidence and selection of discriminating experiments; specialist numerical tools and deterministic controls execute calculations and hardware actions.
recommendation.robotics_role: Fixtures, controlled dispensing/fastening and conventional sample transfer first; learned handling only for demonstrated variable manipulation needs.
recommendation.verification: Known-good and known-cause controls, separate destructive specimens, independent builds/remounts, held-out conditions, applicable durability/leak/mechanical checks and actual-product transfer.
disqualifiers: No relevant owner cases or change rights
Existing expert/DOE baseline solves equally well
Dominant external waits leave no useful improvement
recommendation.why_preferred: Bounded physically changeable assembly and a coupled material/mechanical/thermal/hydraulic decision; evidence supports a testable hypothesis. This is coordinator judgment consistent with independent revisions, not a vote or economic ranking.

alternative_priority: No universal ordering accepted. Internal AC/DC transient-margin work is strongest narrow electrical entry; optical post-stress work has stronger directly reported failed-build return. Access and owner cases may reverse priority.

gaps.question: Which owner has recurring unresolved failures and authority over the required physical/design changes?
gaps.resolution_needed: Authentic failed and corrected cases, limits, change rights and representative specimens; no outreach performed.

gaps.question: Can the chosen measurements discriminate causes and can surrogate results transfer to actual product?
gaps.resolution_needed: Calibration, known-cause controls, remount repeatability, uncertainty, independent specimens and actual-product holdouts.

gaps.question: Does LLM interpretation/experiment selection improve verified engineering outcomes over the same tools and skilled engineers?
gaps.resolution_needed: Matched comparison with expert workflow and integrated deterministic/statistical experiment planning; count false fixes and avoidable experiments.

gaps.question: Are recurrence, avoided iteration costs, budgets and willingness to pay sufficient?
gaps.resolution_needed: Owner campaign records and a measured pilot; hardware consequence alone does not establish economics.

gaps.question: What fraction of delay is changeable versus fabrication, equilibrium or stress exposure?
gaps.resolution_needed: Timestamp complete campaigns and separate active work, instrument time and external waits.

gaps.question: Which detailed thermal/material/optical/electrical procedures and thresholds apply to the owner product?
gaps.resolution_needed: Product-specific recipes and access; do not import source examples or patent/roadmap parameters as target settings.

Not every historical evidence field or original source reread. Replacement reviewers inherited coverage explicitly and personally investigated source challenges.

convergence.basis: All ten discrepancies explicitly disposed; independent revisions agree on conditional thermal lead, scope/evidence distinctions, power splits, retained alternatives and unknowns. Alternative commercial ordering remains unknown, not a resolved market fact.
convergence.not_independent_corroboration: Repeated underlying sources across reviewers counted once.

provenance.reason_for_replacements: User interruption ended original agents before revisions were saved; preserved originals and reused saved source files.

next_evidence_needed: A real owner-controlled failure packet and measured baseline campaign to test access, transfer, integration value and economics. No outreach authorized or performed.
